items.guidance: Since @prisma/client is present, look for a Prisma schema file and any prisma migrate deploy or prisma db push invocation in package.json scripts of the root or workspace packages, the Dockerfile.dev, or the pm2 startup scripts. If the app only uses db push, report that exact non-interactive command as the release migration rather than adding new migrations.

Check what the pm2 script started by the detected start command launches; it may run the Temporal worker app alongside the web and backend apps. Report the workspace or app that imports @temporalio/worker and the command pm2 uses to start it, so it can be declared as a separate worker.

Check whether the backend or worker apps import @temporalio/client or @temporalio/worker on runtime paths such as post scheduling, and whether a Temporal address environment variable exists that could disable it. Report the files and any such setting; if Temporal is required, report that the app needs an externally hosted Temporal server.
